description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractDDataHandler that manages distributed data collections using Akka cluster data, specifically handling Bloom filters of strings associated with ActorRefs, providing methods for reading, updating, removing subscribers, and handling data consistency and synchronization.

classes.name: AbstractDDataHandler
classes.description: An abstract class extending DistributedData to manage distributed Bloom filter collections indexed by ActorRef, providing core methods to interact with Akka cluster data and maintain consistency.

methods.name: approximate
methods.description: Abstract method to provide an approximate measure for a given topic string.

methods.name: getSubscribers
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of ActorRefs subscribed to any of the given topics.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads current distributed data with specified consistency and returns a map of ActorRef to sets of topics.

methods.name: removeAddress
methods.description: Removes all subscriptions associated with the specified network address.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds or replaces subscriptions for a specific ActorRef, either wholly or incrementally based on the topics provided.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a specific subscriber from the distributed data.

methods.name: receiveChanges
methods.description: Subscribes a recipient ActorRef to changes in the distributed data key.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the Akka data Key associated with the topic type.

methods.name: getInitialValue
methods.description: Provides the initial empty ORMultiMap value for the distributed data.
